runs.cmd:

', max(abs(u)), sigma_hat(end), max(abs(x)));" 2>&1 | grep -v warning | tail -6

tests.name: oracle: the estimate of the first pulse is within 10% of d=100, and the estimate returns below 1 after the last pulse
tests.cmd: octave --no-gui --no-window-system -p $HARNESS --eval "techne_run_script('MainL1_ODE1_v1.m'); printf('pulse1_est=%.3f final_est=%.4f\n', sigma_hat(3), abs(sigma_hat(end)));" 2>&1 | grep pulse1_est | awk '{print; split($1,a,"="); split($2,b,"="); exit (a[2] > 90 && a[2] < 110 && b[2] < 1) ? 0 : 1}'
